question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(month AS VARCHAR) as month,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2016' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2016",
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2017' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2017",
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2018' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2018"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) as year,
        SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 6, 2) as month,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY year, month
) sub
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
